    fix(core): resolve DeepSeek's official API `deepseek-flash` name at V4 limits (#11909)
    
    The official DeepSeek API only accepts `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`
    as model names, but the V4 rules keyed on `/^deepseek-v4/`, so the direct-API
    name fell through to the generic 128K/32K row and long sessions died on
    COMPRESSION_FAILED_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED. Both rules now match
    `/^deepseek-(?:v4|flash)/`; older families keep their pinned fallbacks.
    
    Closes #11894

commit.subject: fix(core): resolve DeepSeek's official API `deepseek-flash` name at V4 limits (#11909)
commit.body_excerpt:
The official DeepSeek API only accepts `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`
as model names, but the V4 rules keyed on `/^deepseek-v4/`, so the direct-API
name fell through to the generic 128K/32K row and long sessions died on
COMPRESSION_FAILED_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED. Both rules now match
`/^deepseek-(?:v4|flash)/`; older families keep their pinned fallbacks.

Closes #11894
